# DuoStack

> Engineering studio in Mumbai, India. We build premium web platforms, custom CRM systems, e-commerce storefronts, and mobile apps for ambitious teams in healthcare, fintech, e-commerce, NGO, and automotive. Senior engineers only — two co-founders running every sprint. NDA-first. Founders reply within one business day on email and WhatsApp.

- Studio: DuoStack (legal name: DuoStack Studio)

## Services

- [Web development company in Mumbai](https://duostack.in/web-development-company-mumbai/): React, Next.js, Vite. Marketing sites, dashboards, SaaS products. Starter from ₹20k, Sprint from ₹2L, full Pro platforms from ₹6.5L.
- [Custom CRM development in Mumbai](https://duostack.in/custom-crm-development-mumbai/): Meta API lead capture, Twilio voice and WhatsApp, role-based routing, Mumbai-region data residency.
- [React Native app development in Mumbai](https://duostack.in/react-native-app-development-mumbai/): Cross-platform iOS and Android apps; App Store and Play Store submission included.
- [Shopify development company in Mumbai](https://duostack.in/shopify-development-company-mumbai/): Headless Hydrogen and custom Liquid themes; Razorpay and Stripe; GST-compliant.
- [Fintech and forex platform development in Mumbai](https://duostack.in/fintech-platform-development-mumbai/): MT5 manager-API integration, KYC/AML, trader-grade dashboards.
- [Healthcare software development in Mumbai](https://duostack.in/healthcare-software-development-mumbai/): Patient apps, clinician dashboards, telehealth, EMR / FHIR integration. DPDP Act and HIPAA-aligned.

## Selected work

- Remesleep — sleep and recovery healthcare platform with patient onboarding, clinician dashboards, telehealth.
- OutVue — growth-spend intelligence SaaS for UK enterprises: blended ROI attribution across ad accounts, scenario modelling, board-ready reporting.
- Saad Cargo Logistics CRM — railway parcel booking, POD/bilti generation, party ledgers, GST invoicing and SMS status alerts (private client build).
- SRF Power Genset Sales CRM — generator capacity calculator that sizes a genset from connected load and quotes it, plus leads, inventory, attendance and IndiaMART sync (private client build).
- Baker & Co Visa CRM — end-to-end visa lead CRM with Meta API and Twilio.
- Humane Warriors — global NGO website mobilising donors and volunteers.
- Howl — brand-led digital marketing agency website.
- Benzer World — headless commerce on Shopify with custom CMS.
- Mossano Marmo — natural-stone sourcing platform for architects: verified slab availability and actual slab photography.
- Saum Studio — Mumbai interior design studio: residential, commercial and turnkey interiors.
- AutoPart — booking platform for premium car repair.
- Zaid Electronics — doorstep TV repair across Mumbai with brand-wise service pages and call/WhatsApp lead capture.
- Gouri Furnishing — made-to-measure curtains, blinds and mattresses in Thane with free home-measurement booking.

## Engagement model

Pricing is tiered transparently. Indian rates first, USD shown for international reference.

- **Starter — ₹20k+ (~$240) · 7–14 days**: single landing page or simple brand site, up to 5 sections, form + analytics, Vercel deploy.
- **Sprint — ₹2L+ (~$2.5k) · 2–6 weeks**: fixed-scope custom build for a single product or feature, custom design, CMS or auth, 30-day support.
- **Pro — ₹6.5L+ (~$8k) · 8–12 weeks**: full custom web platform with backend, payments, integrations, CI/CD and observability.
- **Enterprise — ₹25L+/quarter (~$30k+)**: embedded senior team, roadmap ownership, SLA + on-call.

We do not run hourly billing. Every engagement is fixed-scope with the price agreed upfront. Indian payments via Razorpay; international via Stripe or wire.

## How we work

- NDA-first. We sign before discovery if asked.
- Senior engineers only — five-plus years of production experience minimum.
- Source code, designs, infrastructure-as-code, and deployment access transferred to clients on day one of go-live.
- 100% on-time delivery across all 13 shipped products.
- Weekly working demo on Friday, fixed scope on every sprint.

## Stack

React 18, Next.js 15, Vite 5, TypeScript, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Framer Motion, Node, NestJS, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, BullMQ, Twilio, Meta Business API, Razorpay, Stripe, MT5, Hyperverge, Sumsub, FHIR, HL7, Sentry, Plausible, PostHog, Vercel, Cloudflare, AWS, DigitalOcean.
